environment.tasks: worktree build of 0.2.0 at the investigation branch base
environment.codex_cli: 0.162.1 (`codex sandbox`, private CODEX_HOME, no model call)

provenance: Relay registry rows are SYNTHETIC fixtures written by probe.sh from each actor's host-view pid/start; no relay producer ran and no hook delivered anything. Actors are bash copies named `codex` (kernel comm codex). Namespaces: unprivileged `unshare --user --map-current-user --pid --fork [--mount-proc]`, plus genuine `codex sandbox` (bwrap --as-pid-1 with a codex-linux-sandbox helper). All scratch config/state/registry was private and deleted after the run; no live claim store was touched.
codex_sandbox_host_view: codex (CLI) -> bwrap --as-pid-1 (initial pid ns) -> codex-linux-sandbox helper (comm codex; ns pid 1, ppid 0) -> command. Two sandboxes started about a minute apart reported the same pid-namespace inode (4026533719): a namespace inode is reused once the namespace is gone.
